raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

MoRIIO READ loads KV synchronously (`load_kv_async=False`), but outside a FULL target forward it awaited only mamba/KDA reads before the forward and left the rest to the per-layer `wait_for_layer_load` hook. That hook misses the sparse-attention indexer caches and drafter forwards that replay a FULL graph, so a decode step could read KV still arriving over RDMA. This awaits every READ posted in the step inside `start_load_kv`, in any cudagraph mode, and makes `wait_for_layer_load` a no-op.

## Claims

- **Connector-only net deletion** (`moriio_connector.py`, +27 / −75, net −48): no core/scheduler/model-runner/model changes.
- **Supersedes the per-layer hook from #48534 and is strictly safer** — it awaits a superset of today's behavior (all reads, every mode, vs. only mamba reads outside FULL), so no previously-correct step regresses.
- **Prevents** two misses main has outside a FULL forward: (a) indexer K / kpool tail caches (`DeepseekV32IndexerCache` and subclasses — GLM-5.x, DeepSeek-V3.2) that have no `@maybe_transfer_kv_layer` hook; (b) MTP/EAGLE drafter forwards, which pick their own cudagraph mode and can replay FULL (hook skipped) after a PIECEWISE target. Symptom: intermittent long-context recall misses under P/D.
- Steady-state decode (no new transfers) does no extra work; FULL forwards are unchanged.

## Validation

**Unit** (`tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_moriio_tp_ack.py`, ROCm nightly on MI300X) — **34 passed**, incl. the negative control `test_step_barrier_awaits_every_read_before_forward` (with `_has_mamba=False` + 3 posted reads, main awaits `[]` in PIECEWISE/NONE while this branch awaits all 3; FULL unchanged), HMA fail-closed vs attention-only report-not-raise, the `wait_for_layer_load` no-op, steady-state no-op, and producer/WRITE post-no-read. Lint: `pre-commit` + `mypy-3.12` pass.

> CI's `pre-run-check` is red because the author has <4 merged PRs and the PR isn't `ready`-labelled (a reputation/cost gate, not lint); full CI runs after a maintainer labels it. `readthedocs` red is the unrelated docs build.

**Recall ablation (reproduce-then-fix) — pending, cluster.** Long-context NIAH under P/D at concurrency, decode forced to PIECEWISE, with/without this commit:

| arm | expected |
| --- | --- |
| without (main's barrier) | misses when indexer/MTP-FULL reads land mid-forward |
| with (this PR) | clean recall |

**Perf A/B — pending, cluster.** P→D admission-step latency + TTFT at concurrency 1 and 4–8, and steady-state ITL/throughput (expected flat), branch-vs-main, forced PIECEWISE — bounds the one tradeoff (lost per-layer overlap on admission steps).

These are cluster-gated because the GLM-5.3-Flash 1P/1D READ recipe cannot boot on bare `origin/main` (pre-existing gates reject MTP, >1 transferable attention group, and the 4-D indexer view — sibling work), so the A/B toggles only this commit on an otherwise-bootable base; CI has no RDMA P/D hardware. On the combined GLM-5.3 stack both legs boot and NIAH is correct at 2K/8K/32K/96K words, zero transfer errors; the long-context multi-seed variance reproduces on the fork recipe too, so it is not from this change.

## Details

**P/D flow.** D's scheduler admits a READ request with `load_kv_async=False` → `has_sync_kv_loads=True`, so the worker calls `start_load_kv` **before** the forward; `_read_blocks` posts one RDMA READ per layer (attention, indexer K, kpool tail, KDA, MTP). `_await_reads_issued_this_step` then awaits them. Before this PR it awaited all reads only on a FULL target forward; in PIECEWISE/NONE only `Attention`/`MLAAttention` layers called `wait_for_layer_load`, so the indexer read its caches mid-flight, and a FULL drafter forward skipped the hook entirely.

**Why `start_load_kv`.** It is the only connector call that is both outside any graph and before the forward on sync-load steps (`KVConnectorModelRunnerMixin`; MRv2 `ActiveKVConnector.pre_forward`). Async connectors (NIXL/Mooncake) don't hit this — they hold the request in `WAITING_FOR_REMOTE_KVS`. Correctness rests on the eager handshake covering every referenced engine (so reads are always posted on the sync-load step, not a later post-forward one); this PR adds an assert on that invariant.

**Tradeoff.** Non-FULL steps that admit a transferred request lose per-layer overlap; the added latency is at most the forward compute that overlapped the transfer tail. It is a host wait on RDMA completion statuses — no stream/device sync. Fires only when `has_sync_kv_loads` and ≥1 read was posted.

## Not a duplicate

- #58968 **closed**; #53250 **merged** (in base, no overlap); #54301 **open** — makes READ async (the competing direction; larger lifecycle change). #48534/#51052/#59164 (merged) define the current READ flow; this supersedes #48534's forward-time hook.

## Limitations (pre-existing)

- The lazy background-handshake fallback is unreachable on current main (the eager handshake covers every engine — now asserted); a single-token prompt reports 0 external tokens, so its step has no sync load.

## Checklist

- [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill.
- [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR.
- [x] **Design Fit** — connector-only, net −48.
- [ ] **Testing and Validation** — unit + negative control done; perf A/B + recall ablation pending (cluster). Draft until then.
- [x] **Code Quality and Style** — ruff, mypy, typos pass.
- [x] **Pull Request Contents** — summary, P/D flow, root cause, tradeoff, duplicate check above.

**AI assistance:** Claude (Claude Code) helped with the investigation, implementation, tests, and this description. I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests above.

+def test_step_barrier_awaits_every_read_before_forward():
+    # Indexer caches have no per-layer hook, and the drafter may replay a FULL
+    # graph after a PIECEWISE target forward, so every read is awaited up front.
+    class RecordingWrapper:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.awaited = []
+
+        def waiting_for_transfer_complete(self, statuses):
+            self.awaited.append(list(statuses))
+
+        def shutdown(self):
+            pass
+
+    attn, indexer, mtp_attn = object(), object(), object()
+    worker = MoRIIOConnectorWorker.__new__(MoRIIOConnectorWorker)
+    worker._has_mamba = False
+    worker._reads_issued_this_step = [attn, indexer, mtp_attn]
+    worker.moriio_wrapper = RecordingWrapper()
+
+    worker._await_reads_issued_this_step()
+    worker._await_reads_issued_this_step()
+
+    assert worker.moriio_wrapper.awaited == [[attn, indexer, mtp_attn]]
+    assert worker._reads_issued_this_step == []
+
+
+def test_wait_for_layer_load_is_noop():
+    # The per-layer hook must stay a no-op: reads are awaited in start_load_kv,
+    # so touching the worker here would re-introduce the removed per-layer wait.
+    class _Boom:
+        def __getattr__(self, name):
+            raise AssertionError("wait_for_layer_load must not touch the worker")
+
+    connector = MoRIIOConnector.__new__(MoRIIOConnector)
+    connector.connector_worker = _Boom()
+
+    assert connector.wait_for_layer_load("layer") is None
+
+
+def test_step_barrier_without_mamba_does_not_raise_on_failure():
+    # Attention-only (no HMA): a failed read is reported via
+    # get_block_ids_with_load_errors, not raised, so the step can recover.
+    class FailingWrapper:
+        def waiting_for_transfer_complete(self, _statuses):
+            raise TransferError("failed")
+
+        def shutdown(self):
+            pass
+
+    worker = MoRIIOConnectorWorker.__new__(MoRIIOConnectorWorker)
+    worker._has_mamba = False
+    worker._reads_issued_this_step = [object()]
+    worker.moriio_wrapper = FailingWrapper()
+
+    # Must not raise (contrast test_hybrid_step_barrier_fails_closed).
+    worker._await_reads_issued_this_step()
+    assert worker._reads_issued_this_step == []
+
+
+def test_step_barrier_noop_when_no_reads_posted():
+    # Steady-state decode (and producers / WRITE mode) post no reads, so the
+    # barrier must not call into the transfer wrapper at all.
+    class RecordingWrapper:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.called = False
+
+        def waiting_for_transfer_complete(self, _statuses):
+            self.called = True
+
+        def shutdown(self):
+            pass
+
+    worker = MoRIIOConnectorWorker.__new__(MoRIIOConnectorWorker)
+    worker._has_mamba = False
+    worker._reads_issued_this_step = []
+    worker.moriio_wrapper = RecordingWrapper()
+
+    worker._await_reads_issued_this_step()
+
+    assert worker.moriio_wrapper.called is False
+
+
+def test_write_mode_read_blocks_posts_no_read():
+    # WRITE mode never reads: _read_blocks returns before posting anything, so
+    # the step barrier has nothing to await and no release notify is sent.
+    class RecordingWrapper:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.sent = []
+
+        def send_notify(self, *args, **kwargs):
+            self.sent.append((args, kwargs))
+
+        def shutdown(self):
+            pass
+
+    worker = MoRIIOConnectorWorker.__new__(MoRIIOConnectorWorker)

+    worker.moriio_wrapper = RecordingWrapper()

+    worker._read_blocks(

+def test_producer_start_load_kv_posts_no_read():
+    # The producer (prefill) leg only acks the consumer's reads; it must never
+    # post a read of its own, so _reads_issued_this_step stays empty and the
+    # barrier wrapper is never touched.
+    class RecordingWrapper:
